hero.title: Photo albums that feel like a postcard.
hero.subtitle: Upload your best photos, pick a theme for the occasion and share the album with a QR code – on screen or printed on a real card. Your guests open it with a single scan.

how.title: Three steps to a shared album

upload.title: Collect photos
upload.description: Upload pictures or import them from Google Photos and Google Drive. Guests can contribute their own – once you approve them.

theme.title: Pick a theme
theme.description: Birthday, wedding, memorial … every occasion gets its own colours, type, frames and matching reactions.

share.title: Share the QR code
share.description: Show the code on screen, print it on a card or send the link. Optionally with a password and an expiry date.

themes.title: The right look for every occasion
themes.subtitle: Thirteen themes come built in. Design your own with the theme builder.

features.title: Made for people, not for statistics

reactions.title: Reactions with feeling
reactions.description: Every theme brings its own emoji reactions – from confetti to candles.

comments.title: Comments with moderation
comments.description: Publish comments right away, review them first or switch them off entirely.

guests.title: Photos from guests
guests.description: Guests upload pictures, you decide what appears in the album.

control.title: You stay in control
control.description: Password protection, expiry date, download protection with watermark and a link you can revoke at any time.

privacy.title: Privacy without compromise
privacy.description: No tracking, no ads, no third-party servers in the browser. Views are counted anonymously.

openSource.title: Open and self-hostable
openSource.description: Wayfare is open source. Run your own instance – on your server or on Firebase.

final.title: Ready for your first album?
final.subtitle: Sign in, upload photos, share the QR code – done.

viewerCard.title: Want to share albums yourself?
viewerCard.description: You’re signed in and can view albums. To create your own you need the “owner” role.
